alas.title: ALAS management
alas.description: Each Runtime configuration belongs to exactly one user. A user can own and control one or more configurations.
alas.assigned_users_hint: Users with at least one configuration
alas.scope_guide_title: Assign ownership before operating a Runtime configuration
alas.ownership_title: User ownership: choose who owns each configuration
alas.ownership_description: A user can have multiple configurations. Each configuration can belong to only one user, with separate run, edit, and default-entry permissions.
alas.ownership_note: Changing ownership does not copy or modify configuration content in Runtime.
alas.library_description: Status, start/stop, and JSON edits target the selected Runtime configuration. Its assigned user is shown for context.
alas.library_note: Unassigned configurations can still be maintained. An owned configuration must be released before assigning it to another user.
alas.ownership_explainer_title: Manage exclusive configuration ownership and permissions
alas.ownership_explainer: Each user can have one or more configurations. An owned configuration cannot be assigned directly to another user.
alas.selected_user_description: Select a user on the left to manage their configurations and operation permissions.
alas.runtime_explainer: After selection, status and ownership are shown. Administrators can also maintain unassigned configurations.
alas.open_library_hint: Open the library to view Runtime configurations.
alas.select_config_description: Select a Runtime configuration from the list to inspect, start, stop, or edit it.
alas.impact_note: Status, start, stop, and edit actions apply only to the selected configuration. Ownership shows its assigned user or unassigned status.
alas.help_runtime_suffix: first. ScrcpyGate can use ALAS start, stop, and restart actions only after the Overlay is running.
alas.help_proxy: ScrcpyGate is a proxy and control entry point. It does not run ALAS or replace Overlay. Ordinary users can start, stop, and restart only their own assigned configuration.
alas.help_connection_prefix: Enter the Overlay address in “Connection settings”
alas.help_connection_suffix: and assign one or more configurations to each user under User authorization.
alas.help_troubleshooting: If the token is missing, the connection fails, or ALAS control is disabled, check that Overlay is running, the URL is reachable from the server, and the Token matches.
alas.help_isolation: Users see only configurations assigned to them. Configuration content, other users' ownership, and the Runtime Token are never exposed in the ordinary-user workspace.
alas.default_runtime_prefix: The default Runtime address is usually similar to
alas.default_runtime_suffix: . When ScrcpyGate runs in Docker or on another server, enter an Overlay address reachable from that container or server.
